Bbox-vs-ink false positive, not a render defect.

CwVWw/coExp: Camp Plot v2 mobile radial site-map (frame sq6hS, layout:none): this node is a transparent-fill (#00000000) outline graphic, so its bounding box is solid but its ink is only the stroke. The radial street hairlines pass nowhere near those labels. Unavoidable bbox-vs-ink false positive for a map annotation layer.
